collection.description: A mineral spring is said to restore strength, but a weak patient may not survive the difficult journey.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A mineral spring is said to restore strength, but a weak patient may not survive the difficult journey.

choices.label: Carry the consenting patient to the spring.
Bring spring water to the patient.
Study the spring before using it as medicine.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The journey exhausts the patient and worsens their condition.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The patient enjoys the familiar taste and recovers gradually.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The water causes stomach illness, and the healers question its purity.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The researcher finds no reliable evidence of healing.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The spring becomes a place of rest rather than a promised cure.

a1__fx.name: Outcome A1
a1__fx.text: The patient feels refreshed, though their illness remains.
